info.title: API.SH: Proff
info.description: The Proff API from API.SH: public Proff data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Norwegian or Danish company profile, board, owners and accounts
get.description:
One company by organisation number (Norway 9 digits, Denmark 8-digit CVR) or Proff id: registration and foundation dates, status, company type, purpose, contact details and addresses, industries and NACE codes, share capital, register memberships (VAT, enterprise register), officers and board grouped by role (name and role), signatory rules and procuration, shareholders with share and number of shares, annual accounts and cash-flow figures by year for the company and its group (every figure under its account code, amounts in thousands), group structure and parent, register announcements, business units, trademarks, public grants and related companies, with the site's record in `raw`. Birth dates and ages of people are left out.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/proff-company

parameters.name: org_number
parameters.description: Organisation number (Norway 9 digits, Denmark 8-digit CVR). Give this or company_id.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Proff id from a search result, e.g. IF9W5A00VFQ.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: no (proff.no, Norway, default) or dk (proff.dk, Denmark).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Norwegian or Danish companies by name, organisation number or industry (a query that names an industry, e.g. Olje og gass, lists that industry and returns `industry_match`), with county, municipality and post-town filters and revenue or employee sorts. Each company has Proff id, organisation number, name, legal name, phone, email, homepage, visiting and postal address, region, county, municipality, coordinates, industries, revenue and profit (thousands, with the currency), employees, accounts year, status and the listed contact role. `facets` lists filter values with counts; page 1 also has `inactive_companies` and matching shareholders (companies and persons; a person shareholder has name, country and holdings, and its `id` opens /proff/v1/shareholder?person_id=). 25 a page. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/proff-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Company name, organisation number or industry name.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: no (proff.no, Norway, default) or dk (proff.dk, Denmark).

parameters.name: county
parameters.description: County (fylke / region), e.g. Rogaland.

parameters.name: municipality
parameters.description: Municipality (kommune), e.g. Bergen.

parameters.name: postplace
parameters.description: Post town, e.g. Stavanger.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: relevance (default), revenueDesc, revenueAsc, numEmployeesDesc or numEmployeesAsc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Norwegian shareholder (company or person): owners and holdings
get.description:
A company or a person as a shareholder in Norway's shareholder register (give `org_number` for a company or `person_id` for a person shareholder from /proff/v1/search `shareholder_matches`; a person comes back with name, country and holdings, without birth year or home location): who owns it (direct and indirect owners) and what it owns (direct and indirect holdings), each with name, organisation number, entity type, country, share type, number of shares, total shares, share percentage and the source date. Up to 250 entries per list. Norway only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/proff-shareholder

parameters.name: org_number
parameters.description: The shareholder company's organisation number (9 digits). Give `org_number` or `person_id`.

parameters.name: person_id
parameters.description: A person shareholder's id (digits) from /proff/v1/search `shareholder_matches` (type Person).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: no (Norway; the only country with shareholder data).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: Nærings- og Fiskeridepartementet
example.note: Each list holds up to 250 entries, as the source shows them.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
